title: Majority Yajilix Canonical Representation
description: Rectangle grid where some cells hold a clue: a letter (L = turning cells, I = straight cells, X = cells off the loop) and an arrow. The letter is the class with strictly the most non-clue cells in the arrow's direction. Players draw a single closed loop through cell centres, avoiding clue cells.

cells.description: rows x cols grid. null = empty cell, object = clue cell.
